meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后,Codex 在成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑类调用后会自动收到 comment-checker 的检查反馈;一旦报出警告,它会收到阻断性反馈,需要先修复或解释被标记的注释再继续。
howto.when: 当 Codex 成功调用 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑类工具后接管;非编辑工具不触发,检查器二进制缺失时不产生任何钩子输出。

say.text: 这条 comment-checker 警告是什么意思?
say.note: 会解释被标记注释的问题所在。

say.text: 这个注释被 comment-checker 标记了,帮我改掉或说明保留原因。
say.note: 它会修复或解释这条注释。

say.text: 为什么这个注释会触发 comment-checker 警告?
say.note: 它会说明触发警告的原因。

howto.what_en: After install, Codex gets comment-checker feedback after successful apply_patch, write, edit and similar calls. If a warning appears, Codex receives blocking feedback and must fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggers after Codex successfully calls edit-like tools such as apply_patch, write or edit. Non-edit tools are ignored by this plugin.

say_en.text: What does this comment-checker warning mean?
say_en.note: You get an explanation of the flagged comment.

say_en.text: This comment was flagged by comment-checker - fix it or explain why it stays.
say_en.note: It fixes or justifies the flagged comment.

say_en.text: Why did this comment trigger a comment-checker warning?
say_en.note: It explains the cause of the warning.
